name: performance-testing-with-k6
description: A collection of [k6](https://k6.io/) scripts exploring different flavors of API load and performance testing — GET/POST requests, dynamic payloads, faker-generated test data, and staged stress tests against a couple of public sandbox APIs ([restful-booker](https://restful-booker.herokuapp.com/), [gorest.co.in](https://gorest.co.in/), and Grafana's [QuickPizza](https://quickpizza.grafana.com/)).
